items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: when Buddy hired me to play at Lincoln Park, I was there about two Sundays.

ctx.x: That's what after, that's why he gave up going up the balloons.

He's the one who invented this dance ping pong. I didn't know that, no. Yeah. Well, he's the one. Is that son? Yeah. Well, he used to work for the, the guy owned the place and when the guy, I don't know what happened if he died or what, then Buddy taking it over. Buddy was a big shot then, you see.
Buddy Bolden, you mean? Yeah. No, Buddy Bottley. Bottley. Uh-huh. Don't get the Buddies mixed up. Well, didn't, didn't Buddy Bolden work at Lincoln Gardens?
